description: This is an HTML source file defining a web-based user interface for a database visualizer application. It includes embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code for browsing databases, tables, and viewing data with dynamic content updates and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a given database and updates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders HTML table structure from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a cell, handling object and long text content with expand options.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability, handling JSON objects and long strings.
